name: Designer Babies
overview: Scripture reveals that human life is uniquely created by God in His own image, formed with divine intention and purpose from the womb (Genesis 1:27; Genesis 5:1; Psalms 139:13). God’s sovereign design is emphasized by His intimate knowledge and ordination of each person even before birth (Jeremiah 1:5). The Creator alone holds authority over the formation of life, and to challenge His work is likened to clay disputing with the potter, underscoring the sacredness and divine ownership of human creation (Isaiah 45:9).
